title: Model an Expense
prompt: Represent a category, quantity, unit price, and approval limit with well-named Kotlin values. Calculate the total and print a readable summary using string templates.
successCriteria: Declarations use suitable inferred or explicit types.
val is used unless reassignment is genuinely necessary.
The total is calculated once and reused in output.
hints: A decimal price is normally a Double in this exercise.
Use ${expression} only when the template inserts more than one simple name.
solutionOutline: Choose domain names and suitable types.
Calculate quantity multiplied by unit price.
Present the values and total with templates.
verification: Change quantity and confirm the total changes correctly.
Explain why each declaration is val or var.
